content: Webpay Plus return flows (official docs transbankdevelopers.cl/documentacion/webpay-plus, API v1.2): normal flow redirects token_ws by GET (API >=1.1; POST in older versions); abortado (user cancel) arrives with TBK_TOKEN+TBK_ORDEN_COMPRA+TBK_ID_SESION, GET in production but POST in integration, and commerce should use status(TBK_TOKEN) NOT commit; timeout (form 4min prod / 10min int) arrives with TBK_ID_SESION+TBK_ORDEN_COMPRA and NO token; form-error flow arrives with token_ws+TBK_TOKEN+TBK_ID_SESION+TBK_ORDEN_COMPRA together and is replicable only in production. Approval = response_code==0 AND status==AUTHORIZED. Create returns url+token_ws; merchant POSTs form with hidden token_ws to url. Integration card VISA 4051885600446623 CVV 123, RUT 11.111.111-1 clave 123. Voucher must be commerce's own, not Transbank's. status() queryable for 7 days. No iframes.
